correctness.rationale: At every fixed R>0 and mean-zero real C2 boundary profile, the coherent-state boundary integral is smooth in trace-class norm. The disk has simple top eigenvalue 1-exp(-R) with gap R exp(-R). Differentiating its exact monomial matrix and applying the simple-eigenvalue reduced resolvent yields the stated Fourier coefficients. Parseval and an explicit factorial-sum ordering prove strict mode ordering and the sharp degree-two constant. The companion checker independently replayed 1035 finite assertions; those are corroboration, not a proof of infinite-dimensional claims.

value.rationale: An exact second-order sensitivity operator for the full area-preserving shape family of a natural Faber–Krahn spectral functional gives a sharp sharpest non-translation curvature, identifies precisely the translation-null directions and determines how the optimal waveform responds. This resolves a motivated quantitative local shape-selection question left open by global optimality and nonsharp-domain-constant results; it is not an arbitrary truncation or a trivial restatement of disk optimality.
